name: Queue.put
reason: The timed branch (:165-172) is modelled by timedOut as a wait that only advances the clock, but Condition.wait(remaining) raises OverflowError once remaining exceeds threading.TIMEOUT_MAX, so TimedOutcome (put on a full queue raises Full for every Int t >= 0) is false about CPython: Queue(1) holding one item, put(1, True, 10**10) raises 'OverflowError: timestamp out of range for C PyTime_t' on 3.15.2 (and with the difftest's own t*1e-5 s scaling for every t >= 10**15); timeout is Int-only though documented as a number (NaN gives ValueError 'Invalid value NaN' from acquire, also unmodelled). The other entries (fifo, nowait-boundary, timeout-validation, failed-put) are sound.

name: Queue.get
reason: Same timed-wait gap as put (:205-212): TimedOutcome says get on an empty queue raises Empty for every Int t >= 0, but Queue().get(True, 10**10) raises OverflowError on 3.15.2 because Condition.wait(remaining) rejects it; the shutdown-first, block=False, timeout None and timeout<0-before-qsize order is otherwise mirrored and pinned (probe: get(True,-1) with an item raises ValueError, on a shut-down empty queue ShutDown).

name: Queue.put_nowait
reason: putNowait is put(block=False) (:223), which never reads timeout; NowaitBoundary pins ShutDown first, Full exactly when 0 < maxsize <= qsize with the queue unchanged, and putTail otherwise (maxsize <= 0 unbounded), for every Impl.

name: Queue.get_nowait
reason: getNowait is get(block=False) (:231); NowaitBoundary pins Empty vs ShutDown on an empty queue by is_shutdown and getTail on a nonempty one for every Impl, and QueueFifoOrder checks the values.

name: Queue.shutdown
reason: shutdown sets is_shutdown then drains with the `if unfinished_tasks > 0` decrement (:245-256), an exception from _get escaping; ShutdownSemantics pins non-immediate keeps the queue, put raises ShutDown for all block/timeout, get drains then raises, immediate empties and lowers unfinished by the count not below 0 (probe: 1 queued, 1 unfinished after task_done -> 0).

name: _PySimpleQueue.get
